01-the-problem.title: Getting Medicines Shouldn't Be This Difficult

scenes.text: The prescription is in your hand. But the clinic has just run out.
So you start walking. One pharmacy. Then another. Then another.
Hours pass. Transport money runs low. And nobody can tell you where the medicine is, or what it will cost.
You ask around. You call a friend. Nobody is quite sure.
Meanwhile, someone you love is waiting at home.
Sometimes the medicine is just across town. What is missing is the information.
scenes.onscreen: The medicine may be close. The information isn't.

scenes.text: What if finding it was as simple as a search on your phone?
scenes.onscreen: What if it was one search away?

scenes.text: Meet MobiCare. Licensed pharmacies near you, in one place.
Open it on your phone's browser at mobicaresl.com.
Search for the medicine you need.
Licensed pharmacies that stock it appear, nearest first, with the price and how many are in stock.
Compare brands, makers and where each was made, then add one to your cart.
Choose delivery by a MobiCare rider, or collect it from the pharmacy.
The delivery fee is shown before you pay, based on distance.
Then pay securely with Orange Money, AfriMoney, a card or a bank account.
And follow your order, from payment to the pharmacy preparing it.
Have a prescription? Tap Upload prescription.
Take a photo, then drag a box over your name, phone number and address.
Send it to pharmacies near you. Only the pharmacy that takes it sees the full photo.
A pharmacist checks it and confirms the medicines they have, with the prices.
Then choose delivery or collection, and pay. Nothing is paid until a pharmacist confirms.
MobiCare. Search, order and follow your medicines. Discover it at mobicaresl.com.
Fatmata's son is unwell. The clinic has written a prescription, but it doesn't have the medicine.
This time, she doesn't start walking. She opens MobiCare.
She photographs the prescription, and can cover her personal details before sending it.
It goes to licensed pharmacies near her.
A nearby pharmacist checks it and confirms what they have, with the prices and the delivery fee.
She chooses delivery or collection, pays with mobile money, and follows each step.
Less searching. Less guessing. More time for the people who matter.
Licensed pharmacies. Prescriptions checked by pharmacists. Prices you can see.
Find your way to medicines with MobiCare. Explore it today at mobicaresl.com.
